text: The owner’s page. Every pet lists its visits — and the list now has a Vet column.
Booking a new visit for the first pet.
Date and reason, as before — nothing here changed.
This is the new part: a Vet dropdown. It defaults to “not assigned”, because a visit is allowed to have no vet.
Picking Rafael Ortega as the vet who attended.
Saving — the vet id travels with the visit and lands in the new vets column.
⚠ The visit came back with no vet — an em dash. Booking through the UI is NOT saving the vet right now.
The rows above that DO show a vet were written straight to POST /api/visits — that path still works.
Booking is not the only way in. Opening that visit for editing.
The saved vet comes back pre-selected — the read path works, not just the write path.
Reassigning to James Carter. Choosing “not assigned” here clears the vet again.
And the all-visits page, across every owner: same column, an em dash wherever no vet attended.
So: the edit path works, the booking path does not. See finding 1.
